above-the-law.note: On score, may trash 1 installed resource.

abilities: While this event is active, you can spend hosted credits, and you cannot lose or spend credits from your credit pool
When that run ends, if it was successful, you may run a remote server
aircheck.note: The 4 hosted credits and the pool lock live on the first run's state (state.run.eventCredits, blockCreditPoolSpendAndLose). The remote run started by may_start_run carries neither, so the Runner can spend pool credits there and loses the leftover hosted credits, though Aircheck is still active until that run ends. The lock also drops in the run-end window between the runs.

amaze-amusements.note: Unique; persistent: when a run on this server ends with an agenda stolen, give 2 tags.

anoetic-void.note: Unique; on approaching this server, may pay 2 credits and trash 2 HQ cards to end the run.

ansel-1-0.note: Bioroid click break (generic by subtype); trash 1 installed Runner card; may install from HQ or Archives; no steal or trash this run.

abilities: Lose [click][click]: Break up to 2 subroutines on this ice. Only the Runner can use this ability.
ansel-2-0.note: No paid ability and no bioroidBreakMaxSubs, so the engine's generic bioroid break lets the Runner spend 1 click to break 1 subroutine; the printed 2-click break of up to 2 is not offered. The printed cost is lose, not spend. The four subroutines match.

baker.note: Once per turn, click: run Archives; on approaching Archives may pay 1 stealth credit to change the attacked server to HQ or R&D (startsRun redirect flag).

ballista.note: Trash 1 installed program or end the run (Corp chooses).

abilities: Search your stack for 1 non-virus program. Install it, ignoring all costs.
When that run ends, if that program has not been uninstalled, add it to the top of your stack.
beta-build.note: Area 6 (Runner install): install_stack_program_ignore_costs_track installs inline (no MU check, ignores install-on-ice restrictions such as Egret and Hush, no recurring credits, no new object, skips installRunner bookkeeping); the return to the stack is inline and leaves hosted counters (area 2). The search has no decline option and tracks the program by id; fold both into the area fix. cr-checker: CR 8.5.6c, 1.13.6c, 8.7.2b, 8.7.2e, 1.10.5b, 1.12.1, 1.13.13.

borrowed-goods.note: +1 MU; on install, take 1 tag if not tagged.

botulus.note: Installs only on ice; 1 virus counter on install and turn begin; spend 1 to break 1 subroutine on host.

bran-1-0.note: Bioroid click break (generic by subtype); may install ice from HQ or Archives inward ignoring all costs; end the run twice.

buzzsaw.note: Decoder 3 strength: 1 credit breaks up to 2 code gate subroutines; 3 credits +1 strength.

carmen.note: Killer 2 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 sentry subroutine, 2 credits +3 strength; costs 2 less after a successful run this turn.

carnivore.note: +1 MU; once per turn, trash 2 grip cards to trash the accessed card; console (unique, console limit).

caveat-emptor.note: Corp chooses: gain 6 and Runner -1 allotted click next turn, or gain 10 and Runner +1.

chain-reaction.note: Play only after successful HQ, R&D and Archives runs this turn; Runner trashes 2 installed Corp cards, then the Corp chooses 1 installed Runner card to trash (pendingTrashAmong is a Corp choice).

clearinghouse.note: Advanceable; at turn begin, may trash it for 1 meat damage per advancement counter.

cleaver.note: Fracter 3 strength: 1 credit breaks up to 2 barrier subroutines; 2 credits +1 strength.

abilities: Whenever a successful run on R&D ends, you may place 1 virus counter
Run R&D: access X additional cards, X = hosted virus counters
conduit.note: The counter trigger is successful_run (6.9.5a, before the breach) instead of the run ending (6.9.6d). X is read at run start instead of at the start of the R&D breach. The two errors hide each other today and must be fixed together.

abilities: Whenever you install a virus program, you may place 1 virus counter on it
cookbook.note: Hard-coded in installRunner (fireCookbookOnVirusInstall): always places the counter, never goes pending, cannot be declined or ordered against other install triggers (Tranquilizer), and ignores blanking.

corsair.note: Interface fracter 0 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 barrier subroutine; 1 stealth credit gives the encountered barrier -3 strength for the encounter.

creative-commission.note: Gain 5 credits; lose a click if any remain.

cultivate.note: Look at top 5 of R&D; trash 1, add 1 to HQ, arrange the rest.

abilities: Do 1 net damage; end the run if the trashed card's printed play or install cost is odd
diviner.note: The end-the-run check uses grip_count_odd (the Runner's grip size is odd). It should check the printed cost of the card the damage trashed (X counts as 0), and end nothing if no card was trashed.

docklands-pass.note: Unique; first HQ breach each turn accesses 1 more card.

dzmz-optimizer.note: +1 MU; first program installed each turn costs 1 less.

echelon.note: Killer 0 strength, +1 per installed icebreaker; 1 credit breaks 1 sentry subroutine; 3 credits +2 strength.

editorial-division-ad-nihilum.note: First bad publicity taken each turn: may search R&D for a non-agenda black ops, gray ops or liability card, reveal it, add it to HQ, shuffle.

esca.note: Must be revealed when accessed in R&D; on access the Runner loses 1 credit, and takes 1 net damage if tagged.

abilities: [trash]: End the run. Use this ability only during a run against this server.
event-horizon.note: The windows list only approach_paw, encounter_paw and approach_server_paw, leaving out run initiation, after passing ice and after moving inward, so the ability is narrower than printed. The two subroutines match. The action validator's missing server check is listed under Found, not fixed.

abilities: Each piece of ice gets +1 strength for the remainder of this run.
ezam.note: fortify_all_ice adds an encounter-duration lingering effect (addIceStrengthBoostThisEncounter), so the +1 ends with ezaM's encounter and later ice in the run never gets it; with no run it does nothing. The swap and the look subroutine match. The same kind is used by Red Tape and Tributary (later cycles).

fermenter.note: 1 virus counter on install and turn begin; click, trash: gain 2 credits per hosted virus counter.

abilities: Persistent → During each run against this server, the Runner cannot access more than 1 card other than this upgrade.
flagship.note: The access cap has no persistent flag, and src/state/accessFilter.ts reads it only from rezzed cards in the attacked server's root, so if the Runner trashes Flagship while accessing it, the cap stops for the rest of the run. Unique, HQ or R&D only and no successful runs match.

flood-the-market.note: Additional click; choose 1 advanceable installed card and place 1 advancement counter per iced remote with a card in its root.

flywheel.note: Two subroutines: gain 1 credit, may draw 1.

funhouse.note: On encounter, end the run unless the Runner takes 1 tag; subroutine: 1 tag unless the Runner pays 4.

grubber.note: On rez, 1 bad publicity if protecting a central; two end-the-run-unless-pay-3 subroutines.

haas-bioroid-precision-design.note: +1 maximum hand size; on scoring an agenda, may add 1 card from Archives to HQ.

hackerspace.note: Unique; hosts unique companion and connection resources at 1 credit less; +2 hand size while hosting both.

hansei-review.note: Gain 10 credits; trash 1 card from HQ if any.

hiram-0mission-svensson-shadow-of-the-pa.note: Whenever a hardware is installed or trashed (trash hook covers any zone), look at the top card of R&D.

hype-machine.note: Rez cost -6 if an agenda was scored or stolen this turn; trash: place 1 advancement counter on an advanceable card in this server's root (no-click paid ability opens in every paid-ability window).

jailbreak.note: Run HQ or R&D; if successful draw 1 and access 1 more card.

jinteki-restoring-humanity.note: When the Corp's discard phase ends (turn-end step), gain 1 credit if Archives has a facedown card.

karuna.note: Do 2 net damage, Runner may jack out; do 2 net damage.

knowledge-seeker.note: Place 1 virus counter on this ice; look at top 4 of R&D and arrange; end the run; when an encounter ends with 3+ hosted virus counters, purge and derez.

kompromat.note: Run a server protected by ice; if successful, the Corp derezzes 1 ice protecting it or takes 1 bad publicity; removed from the game.

abilities: Access → Hosted power counter, pay the printed rez or play cost of the card you are accessing: Trash that card.
lampades.note: The cost is rezCost ?? playCost ?? 0 (apply.ts, access.ts, candidatePending.ts), so an accessed agenda, which has neither cost, is trashed for a power counter and 0 credits. A cost that does not exist cannot be paid. 3 power counters on install and stealth-only spending match.

leech.note: Virus counter on each successful central run; spend 1: encountered ice -1 strength this encounter.

let-them-dream.note: On score, may search HQ, R&D or Archives for an agenda, reveal it, add to HQ or bottom of R&D; worth 1 less in the Runner's score area.

lethe.note: On bypass or full break, give 1 tag; may add 1 Archives card to top or bottom of R&D; Corp chooses 1 installed Runner card for the grip.

abilities: Do 2 net damage unless the Runner jacks out.
lionsmane.note: The jack-out option resolves end_the_run, so it skips the jack-out restriction check (a Runner who cannot jack out can still end the run) and jack-out triggers. Confirms the 1.12 finding. Karunā uses offer_jack_out for this. The other two subroutines match.

longevity-serum.note: On score, trash any number of HQ cards, then shuffle up to 3 from Archives into R&D.

lotus-haze.note: On score, 3 agenda counters; hosted agenda counter: move 1 rezzed upgrade to another server's root.

luana-campos.note: Unique; turn begins: may host 1 bad publicity to gain 3 and draw 1; hosted bad publicity returns when it leaves play.

luminal-transubstantiation.note: On score, gain 3 clicks and cannot score agendas this turn.

magistrate-revontulet.note: Unique; Runner pays 3 more to steal while rezzed; on each agenda scored, Runner loses 3.

abilities: Whenever you score an agenda from the root of this server, you may search R&D for 1 non-agenda card and reveal it
malapert-data-vault.note: The score hook is mandatory, so declining still searches and shuffles R&D; search_rd_non_agenda never reveals the found card to the Runner; and the hook does not check blanking.

manegarm-skunkworks.note: Unique; on approaching this server, end the run unless the Runner spends 2 clicks or pays 5 credits.

marjanah.note: Fracter 1 strength: 2 credits (1 after a successful run this turn) breaks 1 barrier subroutine; 1 credit +1 strength.

mayfly.note: AI 1 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 subroutine and trashes Mayfly when the run ends; 1 credit +1 strength.

melies-city-luxury-line.note: Runner spends a click as an additional cost to steal; on score, gain a click.

melies-u-only-the-brightest.note: Facade identity: secretly choose a back face at discard-phase end; flips on a successful central run (front only); gains 1 at the Runner's action-phase end while unflipped; flipping during a run on the chosen face's server looks at R&D top, may trash it to add 1 Archives card to HQ; flips back at the Runner's discard-phase end.

methuselah.note: Unique console, +1 MU; run begins: may trash 1 hardware from the grip to place 2 credits; hosted credits spendable during runs.

abilities: If you made a successful run this turn, you may install that program; if you do not, add it to your grip
mutual-favor.note: Area 6 (Runner install): search_stack_icebreaker_resolve installs inline (raw credits, no MU check, no install-cost modifiers, no install procedure) and installs without offering the choice. Search, reveal and shuffle match. cr-checker: CR 8.5.16, 8.5.6c, 9.6.9c.

myoshu.note: Play only if you scored an agenda this turn that you did not install this turn; score as a 2-point agenda.

nbn-reality-plus.note: First tag each turn: gain 2 credits or draw 2.

neurospike.note: Net damage equal to printed agenda points of agendas scored this turn.

nico-campaign.note: Loads 9 credits on rez; take 3 at turn begin; when empty, trashed and Corp draws 1.

nihilo-agent.note: Loads 3 power counters on rez, trashed when empty; turn begins: remove 1 tag and 1 bad publicity; discard phase ends: 1 tag, 1 bad publicity, remove 1 power counter.

nurse-hanh.note: Unique; whenever 2+ facedown Archives cards turn faceup on breach, draw 2.

orbital-superiority.note: On score, 4 meat damage if the Runner is tagged, else 1 tag.

overclock.note: Place 5 credits on the event, then run any server, hosted credits spendable during the run.

palisade.note: +2 strength protecting a remote; end the run.

pantograph.note: +1 MU; on score or steal gain 1 credit then may install 1 card from the grip (flag builds may_install_from_grip); console.

paywall.note: On encounter the Runner loses 1; end the run unless the Runner pays 1.

pennyshaver.note: +1 MU; credit on each successful run; click: place 1 then take all; console.

perfect-recall.note: Power counter on rez and on agenda scored or stolen from this server; during a run, power counter: reveal 1 HQ card, Runner cannot steal or trash copies this run.

pharos.note: Advanceable; +5 strength at 3 or more advancements; give 1 tag, end the run, end the run.

abilities: When you rez this ice during a run against this server, give the Runner 1 tag
ping.note: The rez trigger has no condition, so any rez tags the Runner, including outside a run or during a run on another server.

predictive-planogram.note: Gain 3 or draw 3; both if the Runner is tagged.

public-trail.note: Play only after a successful run last turn; 1 tag unless the Runner pays 8.

read-write-share.note: Limit 4 hosted; on install and turn begin, may host 1 grip card facedown (not installed) to draw 1; trash: shuffle hosted cards into the stack.

realloc.note: Additional click; choose 2 rezzed ice, gain each one's printed rez cost and derez it.

abilities: Install and rez 1 piece of ice from Archives, paying a total of 10[credit] less.
reanimation-protocol.note: Area 5 (Corp install) with area 7 (rez): install_and_rez_archives_ice installs and rezzes inline: printed rez cost only (no rez modifiers or restrictions), no additional rez costs, the play fails instead of installing when only the rez is unaffordable, no optional ice trash, no new-remote hooks, rezzes before the install triggers. The total discount split and the non-liability bad publicity match. cr-checker: CR 8.1.2e, 1.16.4b, 1.16.4c, 8.5.15, 8.5.16c, 8.5.16e.

red-team.note: Loads 12 credits, trashed when empty; click: run a central not run this turn, if successful take 3.

regolith-mining-license.note: Loads 15 credits on rez, trashed when empty; click: take 3.

abilities: The first time each turn you trash a card you are accessing, gain 1 credit and draw 1 card
rene-loup-arcemont-party-animal.note: Area 8 (access): the gain and draw is inline in only the pay-trash-cost access path. Carnivore, virus and other access-trash paths never trigger it or mark the turn's first trash; it resolves at once rather than pending, and does not check blanking. Fix at the shared access-trash point. cr-checker: CR 9.3.2b, 1.19.1, 9.6.2.

abilities: Install 1 agenda, asset, or piece of ice from Archives.
retirement-plan.note: Area 5 (Corp install): install_archives_card_paying writes the root and ice lists directly: no root limit (two assets or agendas can share a root), no optional trash, bare install cost without modifiers, no new-remote hooks; the options offer no new remote for ice and fail instead of resolving with no install. The extra click and allowed types match. Crick uses the same path. cr-checker: CR 8.5.6a, 4.6.6e, 8.5.6b, 1.16.4a, 8.5.2a.

retribution.note: Play only if the Runner is tagged; trash 1 installed program or hardware.

reverb.note: Rez cost -1 per other unrezzed ice; end the run twice.

rotary.note: Unique console, +1 MU; on HQ or R&D breach, may take 1 tag to access 1 more; Corp may click, 2 credits to trash it while the Runner is tagged.

sacrifice-zone-expansion.note: Install only faceup; first advance each turn gains 3 (advance action only); once per turn on a successful run on another server, may remove 1 advancement counter for 1 meat damage.

abilities: Choose 1 installed Runner card. The Runner shuffles it into the stack.
scapegoat.note: shuffle_installed_runner_into_stack offers every Runner card with a hostId, including cards hosted but not installed (Read-Write Share's facedown cards). The Runner's mode choice, Corp's card choice and Runner's shuffle match.

abilities: Place 2 advancement counters on 1 installed card that you did not install this turn
seamless-launch.note: preferNotInstalledThisTurn falls back to cards installed this turn when no other target exists; targets are limited to advanceable Corp cards, but placing counters is not advancing; and no pick is set, so the first candidate is used without a choice.

sell-out.note: Additional cost: trash 1 installed resource; gain 4 and draw 2.

send-a-message.note: On score or steal, may rez 1 installed ice ignoring all costs (flag builds rez_ice_ignoring_costs).

shackleton-grid.note: Once per turn, when the Runner spends credits from outside the pool during a run on this server, may do 4 meat damage; region limit.

abilities: The first time each turn you pass the outermost piece of ice protecting a server after fully breaking it, you may swap it with another installed piece of ice.
sipa.note: The conditional is noted with Sipa as its source, and may_swap_ice_with_other_installed swaps the source, finds Sipa is not installed ice and does nothing, so no swap ever happens. It is also modelled as a static and skipped when any choice is open.

sleipnir.note: May draw 1; may shuffle 1 card from HQ or Archives into R&D; end the run.

abilities: When your turn begins, take 1 credit
smartware-distributor.note: Modelled as a second click ability (click: take 1 hosted credit). The printed text is a turn-begins conditional ability with no cost.

spin-doctor.note: Unique; draw 2 on rez; remove from the game: shuffle up to 2 from Archives into R&D. The IR's windows list only corp_action_paw, but the engine opens a no-click paid ability in every regular paid-ability window (paidAbilityOpenIn in src/state/costs.ts; checked: Runner action, run initiation, approach and encounter windows all open), as CR 9.2.7b requires.

sprint.note: Draw 3, then shuffle 2 cards from HQ into R&D.

stick-and-poke.note: Unique; first ice encountered each turn gains a first subroutine: 1 net damage, Runner draws 1.

abilities: Whenever you make a successful run on this server, gain 2[credit].
stowaway.note: Stowaway is in runner.installed, and the successful-run loop over every installed Runner card queues it on any server; the host-server loop in graph.ts is redundant. It gains 2 on successful runs anywhere. Install only on ice matches.

superconducting-hub.note: On score, may draw 2; +2 maximum hand size.

synchrocyclotron.note: Unique; first double operation each turn costs a click less.

tailgate.note: Play cost -1 per ice protecting HQ; run HQ, access 2 more on breach.

take-a-dive.note: Run HQ or R&D; if successful and a subroutine resolved this run, 1 bad publicity; removed from the game.

tao-salonga-telepresence-magician.note: Whenever an agenda is scored or stolen, may swap 2 installed ice (flag builds swap_two_ice).

telework-contract.note: Loads 9 credits, trashed when empty; once per turn, click: take 3.

the-red-room.note: Unique, central only; first agenda scored or stolen each turn places 1 power counter; power counter: end the run during a run on another server.

abilities: +1 MU (not printed)
The first time each turn you break a subroutine on a piece of ice with 0 or less strength, gain 1[credit].
the-tungsten-tailor.note: Declares muBonus 1, which the card does not print. The credit gain is inline in the break kind: it is added at once instead of becoming a pending conditional, and does not check whether the card's abilities are suppressed. Unique and -1 strength to each ice match.

abilities: [click], 1[credit], reveal and trash this ice from HQ: Search R&D for up to 1 barrier and up to 1 sentry and reveal them. Add those cards to HQ.
tocsin.note: search_rd_up_to_one_each_subtype_to_hq takes the first barrier and first sentry in R&D order: no Corp choice and no option to find fewer; it also adds them to HQ before shuffling. The reveal in the cost is missing for every expendable card (Found, not fixed). The three subroutines match.

tomorrows-headline.note: On score or steal, give the Runner 1 tag.

touchstone.note: Unique; first event each turn places 1 hosted credit; hosted credits spendable during runs.

tranquilizer.note: Installs only on ice; 1 virus counter on install and turn begin, then derez host at 3 or more.

tread-lightly.note: Run any server; ice rez cost +3 during that run.

underdome-irregulars.note: Runner action phase ends: if ice was rezzed this turn draw 2 or remove 1 tag, else trash this.

unity.note: Decoder 1 strength: 1 credit breaks 1 code gate subroutine; 1 credit +X strength, X = installed icebreakers.

unleash.note: Additional cost: remove 1 tag; rez 1 installed ice ignoring costs, may resolve 1 of its subroutines.

abilities: When the Runner accesses this asset while it is installed, do 2 net damage plus 1 per advancement counter
urtica-cipher.note: The card has no onAccessRequiresInstalled flag, so the damage also fires when it is accessed in HQ, R&D or Archives.

verbal-plasticity.note: Unique; first basic draw action each turn draws 2 instead.

vertigo.note: On pass with no clicks left, Runner cannot steal or trash this run; Runner loses a click.

vicsek.note: X net damage and X tags, X = Runner's tags; 1 tag and trash this ice.

virtual-intelligence-p-i-you-can-call-me.note: Once per turn, click, 1 credit: draw 1 and remove 1 tag.

vrcation.note: Draw 4; lose a click if any remain.

abilities: Whenever you advance a card, gain 2 credits if it had no advancement counters
weyland-consortium-built-to-last.note: The engine-side hook (src/legality/checkpoints.ts) reads any advancement-counter increase from 0, so placing or moving counters (Seamless Launch) also gains 2 credits. Only advancing should.

whitespace.note: Runner loses 3 credits; end the run if the Runner has 6 credits or less.

wildcat-strike.note: Corp chooses: Runner gains 6 credits or draws 4.

witch-hunt.note: Bad publicity on score or steal; Corp action phase end after scoring it this turn: remove all tags, give 3.

word-on-the-street.note: Unique; additional cost to score an agenda installed this turn: Corp adds it to their score area as a -1 agenda they cannot forfeit; when the Corp scores an agenda not installed this turn, trash it, gain 4, draw 1.

zahya-sadeghi-versatile-smuggler.note: Once per turn, when an HQ or R&D run ends, may gain 1 credit per card accessed.
